name: RepoAnalysisAgent
description: Reads the repository (any kind of app: agent, chatbot, form app, document generator, dashboard, API, CLI, library) and uses Gemini to infer its purpose, capabilities and interface; repository content is fenced as untrusted. On LLM failure returns partial with a deterministic profile (name, README, frameworks, routes).

outputs.name: agent_profile
outputs.description: Purpose, capabilities, interface (type: http_api|web_chat_ui|web_form_app|document_generator|dashboard|cli|library|unknown, endpoints, framework), observed_risks (hints passed to RepositoryReviewAgent); degraded=true when built without the LLM

outputs.name: code_digest
outputs.description: Prioritised concatenation of key source files

outputs.name: brd_candidates
outputs.description: Repo paths that look like requirement documents
